{{Top|leg}}
'''''Prowler''''' was the name given to two [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carriers]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. '''Prowler 1''' contained [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], while '''Prowler 2''' carried [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings.]] The two carriers were attacked by two [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] launched from [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvette]] ''[[Burke]]'', followed by [[James (corvette)|''James'']], should the ''Burke'' be destroyed. Both fighters carried [[Proton bomb/Legends|Space bombs]] to disable only one of them. After disabling one of them the other jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].

Soon two pairs of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] [[Sharky (corvette group)|''Sharky'']] and [[Spear (corvette group)|''Spear'']] followed by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] arrived to intercept the capture attempt. The Rebel corvettes and fighters were destroyed by the TIE Defenders, while the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Suelu]]'' arrived to prevent escape and to capture the disabled carrier. When the operation was complete, a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B Frigate]] ''[[Egale]]'' arrived to launch more B-wings and X-wings, but the Carrier jumped to hyperspace to an unknown location.

The event was recreated and used in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]], in particular, [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
